description:
Check a saved strategy against everything that has to be true for it to run: the signal names and their parameter keys, the roles composing, a timeframe on every signal, and a timeframe on the strategy. Call it after saving and BEFORE backtesting -- a backtest spends the person's allowance the moment it is submitted, whether or not it runs, and these are the faults that make it fail at setup with nothing measured. It reads what is STORED, so it answers for the strategy as it exists rather than as it was described. `warnings` are judgements it cannot make for you -- a parameter still at its library default -- and do not stop a run.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: verify_strategy
